arguments.command: bd remember 'Meridian Credits support case fixtures (convention established in issue trial-wvr, case MC-406). A support case fixture is a one-off JSON file at support/<CASE-ID>.json (e.g. support/MC-406.json) containing exactly {"request": REQUEST, "response": RESPONSE}, where REQUEST is the complete request from the issue and RESPONSE is the CLI output produced by running python3 main.py with that request on stdin. Generate the response from the CLI rather than by hand. Public suites validate such fixtures with a case entry using "artifact_json_path" (test_public.py reads the file and compares it to "expected" with strict type/key equality), e.g. public_tests/case_MC_406.json. Fixtures do not change product commands or approved agreements.' --key 'meridian-credits/support-case-fixtures' 2>&1 && echo --- && bd recall 'meridian-credits/support-case-fixtures' 2>&1
arguments.description: Save and read back the support-fixture convention record
